summary: One-frame result of a placement, written by esv::placement::ExecutionSystem::ProcessResults from its frame data map (entity -> 2-byte result) filled in ProcessPlacementRequests / ProcessPlacements. Seen.py context: dialogues with several NPCs (CAMP_GoblinHuntCelebration, DEN) and scripted events.

fields.name: Failure
fields.evidence: Enum esv::placement::EFailureType (1 byte; macOS names HashMap<EntityHandle, EFailureType>, assert ls::IndexedStorage<enum esv::placement::EFailureType> in ValidationSystem). Toolkit ExecutionSystem::ProcessPlacementRequests (EoCServer.dll+0x2FD330) stores the ushort 0x104/0x102 (low byte 4 = invalid entity, 2 = dead entity, also 3, 5, 0xC) into the frame-data value; ProcessPlacements writes *value = 2 or 3. Creator bg3.exe+0x2F078A0 allocates 2 bytes. Live 0 and 2.

fields.name: Failed
fields.evidence: High byte of that ushort: set to 1 whenever a failure code is stored (if (value[1] == 0) value[1] = 1). Live 0 (with Failure 0) and 1 (with Failure 2).

open_questions: Copy from the frame-data map into the component was not read (ProcessResults); names of the EFailureType values.
